author: Arachadonic
body:
Hey so like all my life I have been an Age of Empires fan and just now I spotted on steam, the legacy bundle (AgeOfEmpires II HD, Expansion pack for AOE II HD, and AOE III: Complete Collection) is on a sale for 24 hours!

It went from 50 euro to 12 euro! So I just thought I would let yall know in case yous havent seen it and if you do buy it feel free to add me on steam and maybe we could get a multiplayer match going!

Thats all. Go back about your business!
